verdict.rationale: LangGraph is an agent-building framework (the agent role), and the evidence only shows it as an MCP client — MCPAdapter converts MCP server tools into LangChain tools for use by LangGraph agents ([langgraph-docs-22], [langgraph-docs-30]). There is no evidence LangGraph itself runs as or exposes an MCP server, so per the agent-role exception this axis does not apply.
